Title: User registration and login with profile verification
Preconditions: Toolshop application is accessible at https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/; User is not logged in
Steps:
1. Navigate to Register page (/auth/register)
2. Enter valid registration details and submit
3. Verify success message or redirect to login
4. Navigate to Login page (/auth/login)
5. Enter registered email and password; submit
6. Navigate to Profile / Account section
7. Verify displayed name and email match registered data
8. Verify registered address (street, city, country) is displayed on profile
TestData:
First Name: Test
Last Name: User
Email: testuser_<timestamp>@example.com
Password: Valid password (8+ chars; upper/lower/number/symbol)
DOB: 1990-01-15 (age 18-75)
Address: Street 1, City, State, Country, 1234AA
ExpectedResult: User registers successfully; logs in successfully; profile displays correct first name, last name, email, and registered address details

Title: Invalid login attempt shows error message
Preconditions: Toolshop application is accessible; Valid customer account exists (pre-seeded or previously registered)
Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page (/auth/login)
2. Enter valid email address
3. Enter incorrect password
4. Click Login / Submit
5. Observe page response and error message
TestData:
Email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com (or registered test user)
Password: InvalidPassword@99
ExpectedResult: Login is rejected; user remains on login page; clear error message displayed (e.g. invalid credentials); user is not redirected to account/home

Title: Protected account routes require authentication over HTTPS
Preconditions: Toolshop application is accessible; User is not logged in; Browser supports HTTPS
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. Verify the browser URL uses HTTPS (padlock / valid certificate; no mixed-content warnings on the login page)
3. Without logging in, attempt to open a protected account URL directly (e.g. /account/profile, /checkout, or /account/invoices)
4. Observe whether account or checkout content is shown
5. Repeat for at least one additional protected route if applicable
TestData:
Base URL: https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
Protected routes: /account/profile, /checkout, /account/invoices (or equivalent account pages)
ExpectedResult: Application is served over HTTPS; unauthenticated users cannot view protected account/checkout pages and are redirected to login or shown an access-denied state; no profile, invoice, or checkout data is exposed without authentication

Title: Product catalog page loads within acceptable time
Preconditions: Toolshop application is accessible; Stable network connection; Browser cache cleared or hard refresh used
Steps:
1. Open browser developer tools (Network tab) or use a stopwatch
2. Navigate to the home / product listing page (hard refresh or cleared cache)
3. Record the time until the product listing is visible and interactive (products rendered, no loading spinner)
4. Repeat steps 2–3 two more times
5. Calculate the average load time across three attempts
TestData:
URL: https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
Acceptance threshold: ≤ 5 seconds average load time on standard broadband
ExpectedResult: Product catalog page loads and becomes interactive within 5 seconds on average across three attempts; no prolonged blank screen or timeout errors under normal network conditions

Title: Checkout completes using Cash on Delivery payment
Preconditions: User is logged in; Cart contains at least one item
Steps:
1. Open cart with items
2. Proceed to checkout
3. Enter valid billing address details
4. Select payment method: Cash on Delivery
5. Review order summary
6. Click Confirm button TWICE (per application requirement)
7. Observe checkout completion message
TestData:
Billing Street: Zoey Shore
Billing City: Hesselbury
Billing State: Florida
Billing Country: TG
Billing Postal Code: 1234AA
Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
ExpectedResult: Checkout completes successfully after double Confirm; order confirmation or success message is displayed; no payment errors shown

Title: Invoice verification under My Invoices after purchase
Preconditions: User is logged in; Cart is empty at start of test
Steps:
1. Add at least one in-stock product to cart
2. Proceed to checkout
3. Enter valid billing address details
4. Select payment method: Cash on Delivery
5. Click Confirm button TWICE
6. Verify checkout success message is displayed
7. Navigate to My Invoices (account menu)
8. Locate the most recent invoice in the list
9. Open / view invoice details
10. Verify invoice ID is displayed
11. Verify line items match cart products and quantities
12. Verify total amount matches cart total at checkout
TestData:
Billing Street: Zoey Shore
Billing City: Hesselbury
Billing State: Florida
Billing Country: TG
Billing Postal Code: 1234AA
Payment Method: Cash on Delivery
Products: at least one in-stock item added in step 1
ExpectedResult: Invoice appears in My Invoices list; invoice ID is visible; line items and totals match the completed order

Title: Single Confirm click does not generate invoice (edge case)
Preconditions: User is logged in; Cart contains at least one item; Fresh test user or empty invoice history preferred
Steps:
1. Add item to cart and proceed to checkout
2. Enter valid billing details
3. Select Cash on Delivery
4. Click Confirm button ONCE only
5. Wait briefly and check for invoice/success state
6. Navigate to My Invoices
7. Verify whether new invoice was created
TestData:
Billing address: valid test data
Payment: Cash on Delivery
Confirm clicks: 1 only
ExpectedResult: After a single Confirm click checkout does NOT complete; no success or invoice confirmation is shown; navigating to My Invoices shows no new invoice for this session; UI prompts user to confirm again or remains on checkout step

Title: Registration with duplicate email is rejected
Preconditions: Toolshop application is accessible; A registered user with known email already exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to Register page
2. Enter registration details using an email that is already registered
3. Fill all other required fields with valid data
4. Submit registration form
5. Observe validation/error response
TestData:
Email: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com (existing account)
Other fields: valid registration data per TC-MAN-01
ExpectedResult: Registration is rejected; error message indicates email already exists or duplicate account; user is not registered again; no duplicate account created
